rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This Ruby-based AI pair programming MCP server by K4sku provides five specialized tools for collaborative software development: general pair programming assistance, code review, brainstorming, performance analysis, and security review. Built using the FastMCP framework and RubyLLM library, it integrates with multiple AI models through OpenRouter including Gemini, O3, Grok, DeepSeek, and Claude Opus, with automatic gem installation via inline bundler for easy deployment. The implementation is particularly valuable for developers who want AI-powered code analysis and collaboration directly within their development workflow, offering configurable model selection and temperature settings for different types of programming tasks from creative brainstorming to rigorous security audits.
